review_evidence.difficulty_reason: 以McMullen–Schulte的平坦混合定理为明确标准输入，本题仍须沿任意秩选择共同二维截面，证明FAP向下一层共面继承，才能反复构造指定全部三维截面的有限正则多胞形。作者在源224–263实际计算正规闭包的商与半直积，主证364–419据此闭合归纳并推出2^(n3+...+nd−3(d−3))群阶；这些相容性与遗传条件不能仅靠乘群阶代替。保留完整本地继承证明后，此结构构造支持H2；不将标准混合定理自身的证明贡献计为本题H3。

review_evidence.difficulty_reason: 本题在双曲平面中构造保持独立性的分枝探索：先由作者完整的穿越参数测度证明获得sin(varphi)dr dvarphi drho/pi，再用半平面嵌套与分离的几何估计保证每代新探索区域未被以前查询。主证把该几何构造耦合为Bin(2,q)的Galton–Watson过程，并由q=1-exp[-lambda(sqrt(3)-1)L²/(32pi)]得到L^-2尺度及任意给定的存活概率。几何分离、条件独立与强度尺度共同构成超过一般资格考的H2义务；不再按99行长度维持旧H3。

review_evidence.difficulty_reason: The proof constructs an infinite magma satisfying E73 while violating E4380. Its specific obligation is to select a collision-avoiding rule set (right-translation injectivity and exclusion of fixed right values), add the new products a*b=c and, when forced, a*c=d without breaking that rule set, verify the four possible new-rule cases, and preserve an explicit four-element seed violating E4380. The retained author proof of the abstract greedy theorem supplies the countable extension-to-total-operation step. These compatibility and countermodel-construction steps are proved here, rather than inferred from the paper title or delegated to an automated prover.

review_evidence.difficulty_reason: The proof constructs a colored graph refinement that removes cliques of rank greater than two and degree-zero/one vertices while preserving the full correlation group together with its type-preserving subgroup. The non-routine obligation is to make the two new color classes intrinsically recognizable by their distinct cardinalities, use the attached rigid ray-and-tail gadgets to kill the kernel of restriction, and prove that every original correlation extends uniquely and preserves the distinguished subgroup. The author proves all three parts in the retained argument; no realization theorem supplies this construction.

review_evidence.difficulty_reason: The author proof constructs a finite metric action for arbitrary prescribed finite orbit data of a residually finite group. Its decisive step is not residual finiteness alone: adding epsilon times the discrete metric gives a positive lower bound on each nontrivial edge, which bounds the length of every putative shortening path in the finite quotient. Choosing the quotient injective on the corresponding finite word ball then lifts that path back to the original invariant metric, where the triangle inequality rules out the shortcut. This gives the required uniform distance approximation and a finite isometric action. The proof itself supplies the metric construction and no-shortcut mechanism; it does not obtain the theorem by invoking an existing finite-approximation result.

review_evidence.difficulty_reason: The proof constructs a section of the distributional path fibration on X by transporting a finite-support section of its universal cover through the explicitly defined path-lifting homeomorphism and then mixing the path distributions over Y. Its essential obligation is to use the distributional construction for the composite covering, whose support points need not lie in one fiber of the intermediate universal covering, while ensuring that the projected paths all start at the same x and that support has size at most (n+1)(r+1). This source-local construction establishes the covering multiplicative bound and is the H2 residual; the supplied definitions, naturality and lifting lemmas are uncounted prerequisites, not an assumption of the final inequality.

review_evidence.difficulty_reason: The proof builds a set of upper Banach density arbitrarily close to one that defeats every nested sequence of infinite sets and every growing finite-sum window with natural-number shifts. The non-routine obligation is the simultaneous diagonal obstruction: a sparse family of deleted prime residue classes preserves density, while an early shift excludes the zero residue class and a later sufficiently long window uses a nonzero residue as a generator modulo the same prime. The nested sets link these two distinct scales. The complete author construction and both contradiction cases are retained; no external density or finite-sums theorem supplies this obstruction.

review_evidence.difficulty_reason: 本题以 KL–Hellinger 比较为明确输入后，仍须按两模型的真实 Hellinger 间隔选择近/远分支，在同一高概率事件上同时控制密度比和后验错误质量，使间隔从 KL 上界中相消。下界独立设计 Bernoulli 漏见稀有点事件，将其概率精确校准为 δ，并证明后验错误集中产生与上界匹配的 log²(1/δ)/n 与 log(1/δ) 两种非渐近尺度。这组匹配偏差界和事件构造支持 H2；不把单独的 Markov 不等式或标准散度比较本身计为困难。

review_evidence.difficulty_reason: The counted theorem determines the group invariant nu(G) for C2^r plus C6, r=5,6. Its non-routine obligation is to construct a zero-sum-free rank-five sequence whose missing subsequence sums force every proposed proper-coset obstruction to contain all generators. The author then lifts the construction to rank six while preserving a missing sum in the obstructing subgroup and its disjoint coset. Known exact Davenport constants are named prerequisites; the missing-sum construction and coset contradiction remain proved in this item, supporting H2 rather than a length-based H3 label.
